title: logit internals
description: logit observing itself (docs/design/internal-telemetry.md, ADR 0018) alongside the demo's synthetic web traffic. Provisioned by demo/grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dashboards.yaml.

panels.title: web.requests (demo traffic)
panels.description: Requests from the hello-world app -- real visits plus a background synthetic loop -- by status code, proving syslog_in -> json -> kv_metrics -> keep -> aggregate end to end.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "web.requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["status"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "web.request_time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p50" or r._field == "p99")

panels.title: logit.component.events.{sent,received,dropped}
panels.description: The uniform per-component runtime instrumentation every component gets for free (Fanout::send / run_transform / run_output).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.component.events.sent" or r._measurement == "logit.component.events.received" or r._measurement == "logit.component.events.dropped")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["_measurement", "component"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.component.process.duration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p99")
  |> group(columns: ["component"])

panels.title: logit.output.requests (influxdb_out, by class)
panels.description: influxdb_out's own retry-loop detail -- 2xx/4xx/5xx/network_error -- that run_output's single send.duration timer can't distinguish.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.output.requests")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["class"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.process.uptime")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()

panels.title: logit.process.interner.strings
panels.description: docs/known-gaps.md's interner-size observability hook -- the interner never evicts, so this only ever grows.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.process.interner.strings")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> last()

panels.title: Loki: raw demo traffic ({job="demo"})
panels.description: `log_out` (`syslog_out`, docs/adr/0022-syslog-output.md) relays access_json's events as RFC 5424 syslog to Alloy (demo/alloy/config.alloy), which pushes them into Loki -- `host`/`app` stream labels come from the event's own `syslog.hostname`/`syslog.tag` attributes, round-tripped from `access_in`'s syslog_in decode, not from any syslog_out config field.

panels.title: Loki: 5xx lines/sec (LogQL | json filter)
panels.description: LogQL parsing the JSON message body itself, not just matching stream labels -- `| json` extracts `status` from each line, then filters on it.

panels.title: Tempo: logit's own internal spans
panels.description: logit observing itself as *traces*, not just metrics (docs/adr/0025-internal-span-emission-and-deterministic-sampling.md, docs/plans/0005-otlp-end-to-end.md) -- one span per node-visit (listener send, transform process/flush, sink deliver), exported over OTLP/gRPC by demo/logit.yaml's `trace_out`. Open a trace to see the pipeline's real shape: a syslog_in root with json/kv_metrics/keep/aggregate children, or an internal-only root for `self`'s own drain. `{}` matches everything -- `logit` is the only thing sending to this Tempo.

panels.title: logit.internal.spans.dropped (buffer_full)
panels.description: The per-component span buffer's overflow counter (MAX_SPANS_PER_COMPONENT, docs/design/internal-telemetry.md) -- should stay at zero at demo volume; a nonzero value means the demo's traffic is outrunning the bounded buffer between `internal`'s drain ticks, not that traces are being lost silently.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "logit.internal.spans.dropped")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["component", "reason"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
